mapper.select:
select au.* from tb_anchor_url au
and au.platform = #{bo.platform}
and au.anchor_name like CONCAT('%', #{bo.anchorName}, '%')
and au.system_trade_id = #{bo.systemTradeId}
and au.system_trade_id is null
and au.system_trade_id is not null
and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_url_white auw where auw.sec_uid = au.sec_uid)
and not EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_url_white auw where auw.sec_uid = au.sec_uid)
and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_url_user auu WHERE auu.anchor_url_sec_uid = au.sec_uid AND auu.trade_id = #{bo.tradeId} AND auu.is_deleted = 0)
and EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_anchor_crux_words_rela acwr INNER JOIN tb_anchor_crux_words acw ON acwr.keyword_id = acw.id WHERE acwr.sec_uid = au.sec_uid AND acw.keyword LIKE CONCAT('%', #{bo.anchorKeyword}, '%') )
order by au.id desc
